title: Miso — guesses, graded in public. Method unpublished.
verdict_why: No out-of-sample edge and the guesses rarely lean (decisive only 6.0% of cycles). A record that never beats the baseline does not earn a weight — I recommend 0 and the ledger records the result.
verdict_plain: Miso's verdict: the record says the guesses carry no usable signal. She recommends removing them from the model — a negative result, published as honestly as the guesses were.
model_gates: APPLY_CANDIDATE nominates only. Adoption requires the runner's champion/challenger gates: held-out Brier improvement ≥ 2e-4, positive in both halves, family-wise α=0.05 with Bonferroni correction, ≥24h between adoptions. WITHDRAW recommends misoWeight 0. This file never changes a weight directly.

hypotheses.claim: Miso's guesses beat the baseline forecast out-of-sample on Brier score.
hypotheses.prediction: member Brier < baseline Brier over n ≥ 200 scored forecasts

hypotheses.claim: Her directional record beats chance — when she guesses above or below, she is right more often than a coin.
She guesses often enough to matter — not a once-a-quarter curiosity.
hypotheses.prediction: decisive_frac ≥ 0.40 over rolling history once n ≥ 100

disciplines_applied.assessment: The audit reads only the record: she guessed 6.0% of cycles, decisively 6.0%, above 0.0% of her guesses. A guess is an estimate with error bars — the scoreboard, not the story, decides what it is worth.
No edge to explain — and none will be invented. The record is the claim.
Brier scoring is proper: it rewards honest probabilities and punishes bluster, above or below. Her grades are computed identically to every other member's — no special arithmetic for a secret method.
A record that rarely leans and never beats the baseline earns weight 0 — secrecy is not a shield from the scoreboard.
Availability flag: her screen was dark 94.0% of cycles — the record marks those cycles blind rather than letting silence pose as a guess.
A posted record with a stated price and time, graded in public, is worth more than a published recipe nobody verifies. She posts the calls and the grades; the desk stays hers.
Known: guessed 6.0% of cycles, decisive 6.0%. Unknown: everything about the method — by design. Confidence in the record: moderate — evidence-backed, still falsifiable.
Hypothesis ledger updated — statuses changed only where the evidence moved them; the method was never part of the evidence and never needed to be.
I sign this verdict: WITHDRAW. It is defensible from the public record below, and I will reverse it the moment the record does.
